title: SaaS UI lab (source of the SaaS UI pack)
summary: The comps every SaaS UI template and recipe was built and verified in: cursor click, notification toast, toggle switch, KPI tile, sidebar drawer, rolling counter and search typing.
use_when: You want to see a SaaS UI pattern working before using it, copy a comp's objects into a product video, or re-extract a template with comp_to_template.py after changing it.

comps: SU Counter (60 f, rolling digits behind masks)
SU Search typing (80 f, stagger type-on)

carvercat_version: built on 0.1.6 (rev 1105, verification build); re-verified on 0.1.6 (rev 1105,; public release binary, headless; pack added to the bundled Library for the test), 2026-10-27
copy_notes: Each comp has a 'Lab bg' rectangle; templates are extracted with --drop "Lab bg".
Clip ids are unique per comp (cur_, tst_, tgl_, kpi_, sbd_, cnt_, typ_).
Rebuild: ai/scripts/motion/saas_ui_lab.py writes the comps; apply its PRESETS (preset.apply) and MASKS (mask.make + parent.clear), then edit.save.
Lint on SU Counter shows 13 mask-blind warnings (KI-133); every other comp lints 0 errors / 0 warnings.
Rolling counter masks: each Window is the mask (isMask) and its digit column the target; fixed 2026-10-27 (the first release had them inverted).
source: Carvercat team, built with an AI agent, 2026-10-27
